change: Add read-only --seed-status export for saved per-source receipts, AI audits and shared daily ledger. No inference, no source writes, no retrieval/labels/prompts/threshold changes.
reason: Seed stopped at classification failure; ordinary CLI identity has no blob data read permission, and no new RBAC is authorized. Existing Job identity can read saved diagnostics.
recoveryAmendment: Explicit --resume-seed validates unchanged approved original records and all completed receipts/projections; skips completed units; only audited budget_stopped attemptCount0 can resume. Reject sent/ambiguous attempts. Stage preflight reserves the full call upper bound before writes. Models, labels, prompts, thresholds and retrieval code unchanged.
